name: editora
description: Lets Claude see and work in the running Editora: open files with unsaved text, edits you can undo or approve first, diagnostics, search, code review comments and Git status.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to Editora's MCP server through `editora mcp`, which finds the running editor by itself, so nothing needs setting up again after a restart or a new token. Turn the server on in Editora under Settings > MCP Server. Editora must be running for its tools to answer.

editora_command.title: Editora command
editora_command.description: The command that starts Editora's launcher, or its full path (editora-cli.exe on Windows). Editora's Settings > MCP Server > Copy Connect Command shows the one for your install.
